articles.title: Progressive Conservatives, NDP hold on to their seats in Ontario byelections
articles.summary: Little has changed at Queen’s Park after Ontario Premier Doug Ford’s Progressive Conservatives and the Opposition New Democrats held on to their seats in three byelections Thursday. articles.title: PC’s Susan Lahey wins York-Simcoe byelection
articles.summary: Progressive Conservative Susan Lahey has won the Ontario provincial byelection in the riding of York-Simcoe. A campaign website for Lahey lists her as an accomplished small business owner, East Gwillimbury Town Councillor and active community volunteer. She defeated Liberal candidate Naomi Davison and NDP candidate Bobby Nikmard.

articles.summary: New Democrat Fatima Shaban has won the Ontario provincial byelection race in the riding of Scarborough Southwest. articles.title: Vaughan cleans up after severe thunderstorm leaves trail of damage
articles.summary: Wednesday's severe thunderstorm left a trail of damage in Vaughan and crews are out in force to clean up its aftermath, Mayor Steven Del Duca says.

articles.title: Musk launches steering-wheel-free taxi service in bet riders lose ‘no control’ fears and hop inside
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Elon Musk sent dozens of self-driving Cybercabs without steering wheels or brake pedals onto the streets of Austin, Texas, on Thursday, betting that Americans will overcome their fears of rides with “no control” and hop inside.

articles.summary: The Ministry of Labour says it is investigating after workers were stuck on a suspended scaffolding platform at a Yorkville apartment building during Wednesday’s storm. articles.title: Video shows 2 workers escaping moving scaffold during thunderstorm
articles.summary: Dramatic video captures two workers escaping a moving scaffold on a building in Toronto's Yorkville neighbourhood during Wednesday's storm

articles.title: NDP takes Scarborough Southwest, PCs win in York—Simcoe, Hamilton East—Stoney Creek byelections
articles.summary: Ontario's Progressive Conservatives held onto the ridings of York-Simcoe and Hamilton East-Stoney Creek, while the NDP maintained its grip on Scarborough Southwest in three provincial byelections held Thursday.

articles.title: Man charged in connection to fatal Scarborough car crash in May: police
articles.summary: Toronto police have arrested and charged a 39-year-old man from Pickering, Ont. in connection to a fatal Scarborough car crash in May that killed one person and put three others in hospital.

articles.title: Complaints about drug use, violence persist at Barbara Hall Park as Toronto considers its response
articles.summary: A Toronto city task force meant to address ongoing issues at Barbara Hall Park is expected to revisit its approach amid ongoing complaints about public drug use and violence in the area.
